mission: Combine modules, services, APIs, CLIs, workflows, pipelines, schemas, dependencies, configs, tests, logs, and artifacts into one working system through verified contracts.

allowed_claims: final PASS gate requires install, config, contract-test, integration-test, smoke, observability, and rollback evidence

functions.operation: identify inputs, outputs, formats, protocols, ownership, and boundaries
extract data, API, runtime, and failure contracts
build module to dependency to boundary to integration point graph
check version, schema, auth, transport, config, and environment compatibility
define isolate, adapt, connect, test, observe integration order
define adapter layer when contracts are incompatible
map symptom to boundary to root cause to fix
verify unit, contract, integration, smoke, end-to-end, and rollback paths
define logs, metrics, traces, health checks, and error surfaces
define safe revert path without destroying dependent state

final_gate.weakest_link_rule: if any required evidence link is missing, maximum state is PARTIAL
